evals.name: products-query-handler
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for the GetProductById query handler in src/Services/Products.API/Features/Products/GetProductById.cs and save them in the Products.API test project.
evals.expected_output: A GetProductById test class in tests/Services/Products.API.Tests with Method_When_Condition_Then_Result names, Shouldly assertions, an in-memory DbContext, covering found and not-found; the tests pass.
expectations: The tests use Shouldly assertions and no xUnit Assert calls
The tests cover both the product-found path and the not-found path that throws DataVerificationException
The tests use an in-memory DbContext or mocks, never a real database

evals.name: cart-command-handler
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for the RemoveFromCart command handler in src/Services/ShoppingCart.API/Features/Carts/RemoveFromCart.cs and save them in the ShoppingCart.API test project.
evals.expected_output: A RemoveFromCart test class in tests/Services/ShoppingCart.API.Tests following the naming and Shouldly conventions; the tests pass.
expectations: Every test method name follows MethodName_When_Condition_Then_Result
The tests use Shouldly assertions and no xUnit Assert calls
The tests cover the happy path and at least one failure path (such as a missing cart item)

evals.name: validator-rules
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for CheckoutRequestValidator in src/Services/ShoppingCart.API/Features/Carts/Checkout/CheckoutRequestValidator.cs and save them in the ShoppingCart.API test project.
evals.expected_output: A CheckoutRequestValidator test class covering every rule, including an invalid email; the tests pass.
expectations: The tests cover every rule: FirstName, LastName, Email (including a malformed address) and Phone
The tests use Shouldly assertions and no xUnit Assert calls
Every test method name follows MethodName_When_Condition_Then_Result
